name: Night Before Christmas
source:
A Family comes together to celebrate the holidays when an unfortunate food shortage and a suprising guests' arrival leads to the release of explosive sexual energy.

[From [url=https://pandering-games-studio.itch.io/night-before-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一家人欢聚一堂共庆佳节，谁知一场突如其来的食物短缺外加意外访客的登门造访，竟彻底引爆了众人积蓄已久的熊熊肉欲。

[摘自[url=https://pandering-games-studio.itch.io/night-before-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
